source:
@@U03299@@
Stay with her awhile; she'll cure you with her knowledge of herbs, I assure you.

@@U03301@@
Cure? I don’t want to be cured! My mind is sound! I will zot be one of the common herd!

@@U03303@@
Don't fail to drink at the healing spring. Hurry! Dismount! We're at the site!

@@U03305@@
Where have you brought me in this dreadful night through gravelly waters?

@@U03307@@
This is where Rome and Greece met in battle. 珀涅俄斯河 on the right, 奥林匹斯山 on the left, and the greatest empire sunk into the sand. The king fled, the citizens won. Look up! Behold the eternal temple bathed in moonlight!

@@U03309@@
(Dreaming within.)

@@U03310@@
The sacred threshold resounds with horse’s hoofs; demigods draw near.

@@U03312@@
How true! Only open your eyes.

@@U03314@@
(Awaking.)

@@U03315@@
Welcome! I see you haven't failed me.
translation:
@@U03299@@
陪她一会儿；我向你保证，她会用她的草药知识治愈你。

@@U03301@@
治愈？我不想被治愈！我的头脑很清醒！我将成为普通人群中的一员！

@@U03303@@
不要错过喝疗愈泉水的机会。匆忙！下马！我们到了现场！

@@U03305@@
在这个可怕的夜晚，你带我穿过砾石水域到哪里去了？

@@U03307@@
这是罗马和希腊交战的地方。 右边是珀涅俄斯河，左边是奥林匹斯山，最伟大的帝国沉入沙中。国王逃跑了，公民获胜了。抬头！看那沐浴在月光下的永恒圣殿！

@@U03309@@
（内心做梦。）

@@U03310@@
神圣的门槛响起马蹄声；半神临近。

@@U03312@@
多么真实啊！只要睁开眼睛。

@@U03314@@
（醒来。）

@@U03315@@
欢迎！我看你没有让我失望。
